name: Santa Rosa, CA
story: Santa Rosa, California. 9:43 PM, October 8, 2017. The Tubbs Fire started near Calistoga and reached Coffey Park in three hours.
homes_note: Homes are estimated from developed-land cells at pre-fire density (northern Santa Rosa, Fountaingrove, Larkfield-Wikiup and Coffey Park), not individual footprints.
